method.unknown_policy: Unverified runtime geometry/focus/performance is explicitly identified. Unsupported or version-dependent data is not graded as if known.

keyboard.modifier_policy: Exact shared Dialogs.Modifiers matching, including Control/Shift/Alt/Windows. Native child handled keys and open popup priority take precedence; AltGr is not treated as a plain Alt or Control shortcut.
keyboard.navigation_focus: F6 selects the actual in-tree on-screen native current NavigationViewItem; otherwise focuses native TopNavOverflowButton, never a closed flyout item.

active_view_entry.General: Limits Expander, or Honor session limits if a revealed enabled General editor
active_view_entry.Trackers: Tracker editor when draft exists, otherwise Edit

lifecycle.polling: Only current hash/current non-Speed view detail read on existing Session loop. Speed uses the existing tick history owner, no extra RPC. Normal detail changes are matching identity/life guarded.
lifecycle.file_metadata: Core retains immutable Files catalog while same target can reuse it; repeated Files ticks read only FileStats when catalog/edit-date valid. Rename or edit-date invalidates catalog; uncertain rename never automatically resends and forces refresh in current life.
lifecycle.hidden_ui: Release clears file wrappers/ItemsSource, peer/tracker ItemsSource, bitmap/overlay/layout/tooltip/flash and SpeedChart sample reference. A single staged General/Tracker draft may survive view navigation; hidden expensive pieces/history payload does not.
lifecycle.theme: Pieces uses native ThemeResource brush DPs, per-brush Color callbacks, actual-theme queue and one window ThemeSettings observer lazily created only active/loaded/valid AppWindowId. Release unsubscribes callbacks/observer and invalidates queued revisions. No palette cache or always-running timer.
lifecycle.virtualized_lists: Peers and Trackers reuse Synapse.TableView. Files retains native TreeView virtualization and only realized rows for layout. Source inspection does not establish measured memory/frame cost.

ergonomic_concerns.issue: General promotes a long settings editor ahead of transfer/identity diagnostics; keyboard entry defaults to Limits.
ergonomic_concerns.effect: A user investigating a selected torrent must open lower disclosures; entering General via shortcuts places focus on configuration rather than the overview.
ergonomic_concerns.minimal_candidate: Reorder compact diagnostic General facts first and keep Limits as later explicit configuration disclosure; design review required.

ergonomic_concerns.issue: Selected-file size is shown, but all-file byte total is not, although already loaded.
ergonomic_concerns.effect: Partial selections lack immediately visible full-vs-selected size context.
ergonomic_concerns.minimal_candidate: Conditional full size beside selected size; avoid duplicating Pieces count/size everywhere.

ergonomic_concerns.issue: Selected peer diagnostics repeat table identity/rates/connection before choke/interest lines; facts viewport is bounded.
ergonomic_concerns.effect: Essential choke/interest facts can be below repeated facts and need scrolling.
ergonomic_concerns.minimal_candidate: Keep endpoint readable, prioritize choke/interest diagnosis; avoid repeated row data in default selected-facts block.

ergonomic_concerns.issue: Speed plot has no visible rate-axis scale or time-axis tick labels and no hover interrogation.
ergonomic_concerns.effect: Viewer sees shape/current rates/span/peaks but cannot read an intermediate graph value or stable y-scale.
ergonomic_concerns.minimal_candidate: Only after design review, compact factual axis limits or hover facts using existing samples; no new timer/history owner.

ergonomic_concerns.issue: Files metric widths are based on current realized rows and recalculated on row load.
ergonomic_concerns.effect: Widths could change during scrolling when wider metric values appear; no observed jitter claim.
ergonomic_concerns.minimal_candidate: Observe actual scroll/text-scale behavior before altering the one-owner layout.

ergonomic_concerns.issue: Long wrapping single-file path in fixed Auto selected footer can raise semantic minimum considerably.
ergonomic_concerns.effect: Very long paths or high text scaling can reduce tree viewport; compact full-pane switch may be reached.
ergonomic_concerns.minimal_candidate: Measure through real desktop before proposing bounded path disclosure; full copy/identity must remain.

steps: Select one torrent in main table.
Alt+D opens Details.
General presents status, meaningful progress, both rates and stopping/stalled diagnostics.
Alt+T opens transfer totals; Alt+I opens metadata.
user_journeys.friction: General keyboard entry targets Limits; full byte total and temporal diagnostics are absent.

steps: General: Alt+L opens Limits.
Alt+D toggles download limit; Alt+N enters value.
Ctrl+S flushes pending NumberBox text, validates, sends captured-hash options.
On failure retained draft stays editable; on success changes saved and disclosure closes.
Alt+2 selects Files.
Ctrl+F filters names; Enter enters tree.
Use native folder expansion/multiple selection.
Read Wanted and affected-count footer.
Alt+W Download or Alt+K Skip applies captured descendant file ordinals directly.
Files: select one folder/path.
F2 opens shared Rename Form with full identity.
Enter valid changed basename; commit Rename.
Known rejection retains name/focus; uncertain response is not automatically repeated and Core refreshes catalog.
Alt+3 opens Peers.
Read connected/supplying/receiving counts; sort Download or Peer has.
Select peer; inspect directional interest/choke facts.
Ctrl+C copies full endpoint.
user_journeys.friction: Loaded discovery-source counts and webseed URLs are unavailable in UI; compact footer may scroll.

steps: Alt+4 opens Trackers.
Select row; inspect last completed result independent of current activity; Ctrl+C copies full URL.
Alt+E opens tier list; edit one URL per line with blank tier separators.
Ctrl+S saves; Alt+R Reannounce is a torrent-wide direct command.
Alt+5 opens Speed.
Wait existing tick observations.
Read solid download/dashed upload, current rates, span and both peaks.
user_journeys.friction: Observation starts here; no earlier history or intermediate readout.

steps: Alt+6 focuses Pieces map.
Read all-piece summary and legend.
Arrow/Home/End explore adaptive ranges; focused tooltip reports truthful counts.
Ctrl+C copies current range facts.
user_journeys.friction: One block may aggregate multiple pieces; nominal piece size does not give exact last-range bytes.

user_journeys.task: Leave a dirty draft or recover a failed detail read
steps: Target change, Details close or window close invokes Save/Discard/Cancel; Cancel preserves target and editor.
Live detail failure shows contextual unavailable row.
F5 clears failure and next existing tick retries without new poller or focus jump.
